task.description:
Fix test DB authentication failure blocking integration tests.

Observed blocker from TEST-RUNNER rerun:
- integration: pg.Conn.connectUrl -> error.AuthenticationFailed
- 352 failures due DB auth

Tasks:
1. Validate DB credentials used by test harness:
   - BPM_TEST_DB_URL currently expected: postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test
2. Verify db_test container credentials and DB exist:
   - docker-compose ps
   - docker exec <db_test_container> psql -U bpm -d bpm_test -c 'SELECT 1'
3. If credentials mismatch, fix by updating docker-compose env for db_test or recreating role/password in db_test.
4. Ensure migration/test scripts and .vscode/run-zig-test-integration.ps1 use same credentials.
5. Verify unblock by running exactly:
   cmd /c 'set BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5433/bpm_test&& set BPM_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080&& set BPM_IDP_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8081&& zig build test-integration -- --test-filter tm01_tenant_list'
6. Return PASS only when command can connect and execute tests (may fail on assertions, but no authentication failure).

If code/config edits are needed, commit and push to feature/WF02-f8-batch1-20260606.
acceptance_criteria: Focused integration test command runs without auth errors

result.summary: Validated db_test auth path end-to-end with expected bpm:bpm credentials on localhost:5433. Evidence: docker exec psql check returned 1 row, host URL psql check returned 1 row, and the required focused integration command started by cleaning and connecting to the test database without any pg.Conn.connectUrl AuthenticationFailed output.
